name: 10-25976-hhap-rs20
notes: The Trout River Environmental Committee Water Quality Monitoring program has been created to provide consistent and reliable annual data on surface water quality within the Stanley and Hope rivers watersheds.  The goal of this program is to collect reliable data on multiple physio-chemical parameters so that long-term trends in surface water quality can be observed.  Since 2014, funding and resources for this program have been provided by CURA H2O and the PEI Watershed Management Fund.

notes_translated.en: The Trout River Environmental Committee Water Quality Monitoring program has been created to provide consistent and reliable annual data on surface water quality within the Stanley and Hope rivers watersheds.  The goal of this program is to collect reliable data on multiple physio-chemical parameters so that long-term trends in surface water quality can be observed.  Since 2014, funding and resources for this program have been provided by CURA H2O and the PEI Watershed Management Fund.
notes_translated.fr: Le programme de surveillance de la qualité de l'eau du Comité environnemental de Trout River a été créé pour fournir des données annuelles cohérentes et fiables sur la qualité des eaux de surface dans les bassins versants des rivières Stanley et Hope. L'objectif de ce programme est de recueillir des données fiables sur de multiples paramètres physico-chimiques afin d'observer les tendances à long terme de la qualité des eaux de surface. Depuis 2014, le financement et les ressources de ce programme sont fournis par CURA H2O et le PEI Watershed Management Fund.
